title: test(spec): under a prerelease package label the retired-after census refuses the release triple, and the retiredAfter TSDoc names the newest published stable release
body:
Fixes #23042
Clause-②: no (the published accept set does not change: `retiredAfter` keeps its `${number}.${number}.${number}` type; the census is a repository test, and the TSDoc states the rule the PUBLISHED rule already implies)

Under a prerelease package label (`18.0.0-next.N`, Changesets pre mode), a new retirement now has a stamp that tsc, the census and the PUBLISHED rule all accept: **the newest published stable release**, which sits below the label's release triple. The census reads the label with semver precedence (`x.y.z-PRE` precedes `x.y.z`), so `18.0.0` is refused now, during the prerelease. Before this change it passed until the census refresh after `18.0.0` ships. The `retiredAfter` TSDoc states the rule for both labels.

This follows triage's direction on the card (comment 6124786465) and card option B. The governed playbook half (`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md:204-205`) is #23057's surface; #23057 remains open and this PR does not edit that file.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/retired-after.census.test.ts`
  - One helper, `atOrBelowLabel(v, label)`. A stable label `x.y.z` admits `x.y.z`, as before. A prerelease label admits only versions strictly below `x.y.z`. All three comparisons against the label use it: the census well-formedness check, the "never above the package label" check, and the UNPUBLISHED release-pending range.
  - The UNPUBLISHED rule is now one function, `unpublishedStampProblem(v, label, lastCensused)`. The label is an argument, so tests can simulate any label without depending on `package.json`. Under a prerelease label the range is `[last censused, x.y.z)`. A prerelease label never takes the exact-label branch: the census never records a prerelease tarball, and that branch's stamp would be the release triple.
  - Failure text under a prerelease label tells the author to stamp the newest published stable release, never the release triple. The stable-label text is unchanged byte for byte (measured below).
  - Three new pins under a simulated label:
    - A stable label keeps the inclusive range and the exact-label rule.
    - A prerelease label refuses `18.0.0` and `18.0.1` and admits `17.4.0`, `17.7.0` and `17.7.1`, under both `18.0.0-next.0` and `18.0.0-next.12`. It keeps the range open even when the census holds `18.0.0`.
    - `atOrBelowLabel` on both labels.
  - Docblock: the UNPUBLISHED rule and the label paragraph now state the rule. The sentence that deferred the question to the artifact door ("this file follows that rule rather than settling it") is gone. The paragraph also covers the card's unmeasured case: a stable `17.x` maintenance release published during the 18 prerelease without the retirement still accepted the old shape. Once it is censused, it raises the range's lower bound, and the entry is re-stamped to it. After GA, the PUBLISHED rule names that release as "just before" `18.0.0`, because the census sorts stable releases by semver.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/types.ts`: the `RetiredConversionState.retiredAfter` TSDoc. The old sentence was "it is the package's version label at the moment the retirement lands", which has no value that type-checks under a prerelease label. It now says the newest stable release at the moment the retirement lands. Under a stable label that is the label itself. Under a prerelease label it is the newest published stable release, below `x.y.z`. The maintenance-release case is stated too.
- `.changeset/23042-retired-after-prerelease-stamp.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`. The TSDoc ships: before this change, `dist/types-*.d.ts` and `.d.mts` carried the old sentence (2 files). After the rebuild they carry the new text once each, and the old sentence 0 times. The census test ships nothing: `files[]` publishes `dist` and `src/**/*.zod.ts`, and `retired-after.census` has 0 hits in `dist/**/*.js`.

Not touched: `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` and the census JSON (no row needed). `check:generated` names no stale artifact.

## Measurements

All runs on this branch. Single-file runs use `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/conversions/retired-after.census.test.ts`. Every mutation went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, and every restore was proven by the tool: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

- **Premise reproduced at base `21c86444e`**, before any edit. With the label set to `18.0.0-next.0` (blob `9eba400e` to `73244d5e`) and `declared-index-unique-scope` stamped `18.0.0` (blob `96d69e4b` to `babee78a`), the census gave `Tests 9 passed (9)`. Base admits `18.0.0`.
- **Reverse verification at `2e7bb5fb2`**, same two mutations: `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)`. Red as expected. The "never above the package label" check and the UNPUBLISHED check both name `declared-index-unique-scope`.
- **Real registry under a prerelease label** (label mutation only): `Tests 12 passed (12)`. No retired entry stamps a value this narrowing refuses.
- **Ablation 1**: the prerelease arm of `atOrBelowLabel` changed from "`cmp(v, release)` less than 0" to "less than or equal to 0" (blob `7607c543` to `c094d14e`). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)`; the prerelease pin and the precedence pin go red. A first attempt passed a repo-relative test path, ran no test file ("FILTER SELECTED NOTHING"), and counts as void.
- **Ablation 2**: the `!prerelease &&` guard on the exact-label branch removed (blob `7607c543` to `3b70eb08`). Result: `Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`; the "census holds `18.0.0`" pin goes red.
- **Stable-label text is byte-identical.** The base census file was copied in temporarily and run beside the new one under the same mutations, then deleted (tree clean afterwards).
  - Label `17.4.0` (census caught up, so the exact-label branch): the 22-entry UNPUBLISHED failure lists are byte-identical.
  - Real label `17.7.0` with one stamp at `17.8.0` (the pending branch): the range message `outside [17.4.0, 17.7.0] — refresh the census (...)` is identical.
  - The "never above the package label" message differs only in vitest's own matcher suffix (`expected false to be true` instead of `expected 1 to be less than or equal to 0`). The author-facing part, `ID: retiredAfter V > label 'L'`, is identical.
- **Stamps on `main`** (from `ALL_CONVERSIONS`, at `21c86444e`, which includes PR #22990): 117 retired entries out of 134. The highest stamp is `17.7.0`, on 5 entries; no stamp reaches `18.0.0`. `packages/spec/package.json` reads `17.7.0`, and `.changeset/pre.json` has `mode: pre`, `tag: next`.

## Tests and gates (head `e10a43372`, merge base `bcebd8409`)

- `src/conversions` at `e10a43372`: `Test Files 11 passed (11)`, `Tests 448 passed (448)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` at `e10a43372`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` is OK. The census test is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`: 1 hit) and has 0 debt rows.
- Whole spec `local` project at `2e7bb5fb2`, before the second main merge: `Test Files 659 passed (659)`, `Tests 19990 passed | 1 todo`. **Declared narrowing**: at `e10a43372` that run was cut by the 595 s foreground cap under lock contention. The merge brought in spec files from other PRs and changed none of this diff's files, so that run is left to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated` at `e10a43372`: `All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 83 commands at `e10a43372`. All were run with exit codes captured before any pipe; `--ran` reports `83 derived, 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN`.
  - 81 exit 0. That includes `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, after a `git fetch --depth=1` of its pinned fixture commit; `check:lean-entry-closure`, after an objectql closure build; and `check:query-options-erasure`, re-run alone with a longer cap.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. Reason: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, it needs a whole-workspace `dist`. This diff changes no build input it reads.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt`. Reason: whole-workspace build, CI owns it.
  - `--ran` also printed a stale-tree note: `origin/main` moved 7 commits past this head during the run (to `287fd6e5d`). The one derived-from file that changed is `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`. This diff adds no engine double.
- Lint, narrowed to the 2 touched TypeScript files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports files 2, errors 0, warnings 0. Both files are in the population (`--print-config` resolves 4 and 5 rules). No type-aware linting is configured (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- A control-byte self-scan of the 3 changed files has 0 hits, and `check:nul-bytes` exits 0.

## Acceptance notes

Sweep of shipped sentences that state the stamp rule. `git grep` covered `packages/spec/src`, `packages/metadata-core`, `packages/spec/scripts`, `scripts` and `content/docs`, for "version label", "package label", "label at the moment" and `retiredAfter`. Each hit is either fixed here or listed below as outside this PR's file surface.

- `packages/spec/scripts/build-retired-after-census.ts`, header section "When to run it". It describes the release-pending tolerance as `[last censused release, package.json label]`. Under a prerelease label the upper bound is now exclusive of the release triple. The section defers to the test's docblock, and the script is not published. Outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts` module docblock (the `M.0.0` bullet) and `artifact-forward-conversion.test.ts` (the major-step block's docblock). Both say that during the prerelease "the package label still names the last 17.x release". That holds only until the first pre-mode Version Packages PR writes `18.0.0-next.N`. Their stamp half ("stamped at or below that label", meaning the last 17.x release) agrees with this rule. The test docblock's "stamped at the prerelease label" means `17.7.0`. The door's verdicts do not depend on the stamp for step-18 entries. Noted, not filed.
- `packages/metadata-core/CHANGELOG.md:489`, a released entry: "the package's own version label at that moment". It was accurate for the stable labels of its release and is release-owned. No action.
- `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md:204-205` ("`packages/spec/package.json` 的当前版本标签"). This is #23057's surface; that card is blocked on this one.
- `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` (the 2026-09-30 amendment) defines `retiredAfter` as "the last published `@objectstack/spec` whose authoring surface still accepted the old shape". That agrees with this rule, so no finding.

The PR body is written once, at creation.
